nuggets.text: The Raiders are 2-0 for the first time since their 2018 championship season.
The Raiders are playing their first Division I game in Michigan since visiting Michigan State in 1930.
Colgate celebrates Colgate Day every Friday the 13th, because 13 men founded the school in 1817.
The Raiders' 1932 team was undefeated, untied, unscored upon and uninvited, outscoring foes 234-0.
Matt Fogler caught three touchdown passes against Holy Cross, the second three-TD game of his career.
Danny Shaban leads the Patriot League at 154 rushing yards per game after a career-high 214 at Fordham.
Head coach Curt Fitzpatrick won a Division III national title at Cortland in 2023 before coming to Colgate.
Edge rusher Jordan Edgecomb, fittingly, recorded a sack in his first college game.
The Raiders reached the 2003 Division I-AA title game, the only Patriot League team ever to do so.
Saturday is the first-ever meeting between the Raiders and Central Michigan.
